explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration with this statement. The theorem is a specific asymptotic result. If a sequence of vectors p n has norm tending to infinity and its normalized direction tends to ν, and ⟪ν,z⟫ < 0, then eventually ‖p n + z‖ < ‖p n‖. I grepped Mathlib/Analysis for norm_add_lt lemmas and inner-product norm inequalities. The only hit was norm_add_lt_of_not_sameRay, which is the triangle-inequality strictness and unrelated. The proof combines norm_add_sq_real with limit arguments, so no single Mathlib lemma covers it.
